# TheoGuard
> AI-powered theological discernment platform for pastors, church leaders, and ministry directors.

## About
TheoGuard is a multi-tool platform that helps churches guard what enters their pulpits, playlists, and platforms. It uses AI (GPT-4o) calibrated to historic Christian orthodoxy to analyze sermons, books, worship songs, and speakers — returning structured theological reports with doctrinal scores, severity-rated alerts, and actionable pastoral recommendations.

## Tools
- /: Theological Content Analysis — analyze PDF sermons, Word documents, YouTube sermons, book titles, and plain text for doctrinal soundness, psychological frameworks, worldly philosophies, hermeneutical methodology, and confessional alignment
- /: Worship Song Analysis — score worship songs across Biblical Faithfulness, God-centeredness, Doctrinal Clarity, Trinitarian Clarity, Gospel Substance, and Congregational Singability
- /: Speaker & Conference Vetting — build a 12-category theological profile of any speaker using their name, public statements, bio, or sermon recordings
